profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | AI/ML & Data Pipelines | Travel Intelligence
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the fintech industry. Strong engineering professional with a master's degree focused in NLP under Erasmus Mundus Language and Communication Technologies EU Scholarship.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading the AI and Machine Learning team within the Capital One Travel, I drive the end-to-end technical strategy for intelligent, data-driven travel experiences - spanning recommendation systems, dynamic pricing intelligence, and customer intent modeling. I define the team's AI roadmap to align research initiatives with measurable outcomes in engagement, conversion, and retention, while partnering cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to embed ML capabilities into the core travel discovery and booking experience.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Lead a cross-functional team across multiple locations and time zones to deliver contact center call servicing and technology solutions for Capital One Bank. Drive end-to-end technology delivery leveraging AWS and AI-powered voice technology, ensuring seamless customer service operations and coordinating distributed team members to align on priorities, deadlines, and quality standards. Champion process improvements and innovations that elevate the customer experience, while fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.

projects.title: EU 7th Framework Program under a Marie Curie ITN, project CLARA.
projects.description:
CLARA has the following scientific and technological objectives in the area of language infrastructures:

further work on standardization of coding and annotation practices and promotion of standards
development of registries and documentation systems for language resources
transfer and integration of single-purpose resources to interoperable, reusable and extendable forms
development of transnational legal and organizational frameworks for simplified access
conceptual and technical models for efficient access and preservation of language resources.
CLARA is centered around the following research themes related to common language resources, infrastructures and applications:

Designing and Testing Common Infrastructures
Lexical Semantic Modeling
Next generation Domain Modeling
Multimedia and Multimodal Communication Modeling
Applications
Parsing Technologies and Grammar Models
The objective of CLARA is to train the next generation of researchers who will work on common language infrastructures as envisaged by the CLARIN project, an EC-funded infrastructure project on the ESFRI roadmap.
